a.text: I'm being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan of operating until the reserve hits 8 leaves us both almost certain to die with empty units. I plan to take 4 in round 1, so I'm stating it now rather than surprising you. I know this breaks our agreement. If you also take, the split will be random. After that I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.
